blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – The Mandaue City Council has authorized Mayor Thadeo Jovito “Jonkie” Ouano to sign a letter of no objection, allowing the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) to proceed with the earth-balling and relocation of trees for the construction of the fourth Mandaue-Mactan bridge. The earth-balling activity is part of the preliminary preparations for the bridge project, which will connect Mandaue City and Mactan Island. According to City Councilor Carlo Fortuna, most of the trees identified for earth-balling are in Barangay Paknaan. The relocation is expected to take a couple of weeks.
